theorems.name: Submission.idod_nearby_center_ball_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y y' : Euclid P) (Λ r τ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ Λ → 0 < τ → τ < r → dist y' y < τ → θ₁ * (r / (r - τ)) ^ n ≤ θ₂ → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y' ρ)) (Ioo 0 r) → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * r) / r ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y r) ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal θ₁ → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r - τ → T.massOn (ball y' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
